evidenceType: Installed native UHT signatures, global script-object paths and native code

activationOrder.conclusion: Registering an external weapon after this function returns cannot prepare its first activation.

externalRegistration.conclusion: Updates the ability-handle to weapon-config association and removes stale entries. It does not construct or equip weapon actors.

weaponResolution.conclusion: Resolves the granted spec SourceObject and searches actual equipped weapon records. A config-only fallback can return no weapon actors and Index=-1.

equipmentBypassSupport: CharacterWeaponsComponent.SetSlotWeapon can temporarily install a real CharacterWeaponConfig into the current runtime slot. Its native path creates actors/components and grants abilities; replacing that same slot with its saved original config restores the normal component lifecycle.

slotTags.source: Serialized names in BP_ShachiAbility_Base and GA_Hun_ChiRen_C

temporaryComponentFlow: Read the actual current index with WithPending=false and save GetSlotWeapon(...).WeaponConfig.
Call SetSlotWeapon on that same slot and index with the requested actual configuration. The selected-slot branch replaces actors, owned/equipped grants, effects and tags.
Request the original normal exact-class activation after SetSlotWeapon returns.
Keep the temporary configuration while the action and its native follow-ups need it; then restore the original saved configuration through SetSlotWeapon.

componentEvidence.removeOld: Removes old grants/effects/tags and destroys old actors/components before replacing the config.
componentEvidence.createObjects: 0x145ed7ef7 calls 0x145ec4ba0, which uses AddComponentByClass at 0x145ec4e09 and FinishAddComponent at 0x145ec4ec2, then creates/registers real WeaponActors and Scabbards.
componentEvidence.grantAndEquip: 0x145ed7ff1/0x145ed8043 and the selected-slot branch follow actual config ability/effect/tag arrays.
componentEvidence.notifications: Native SetSlotWeapon broadcasts the equipment delegate through 0x145e54200.
componentEvidence.actualGrant: 0x145eaff80 calls ASC GiveAbility at 0x145eb021a, using the configuration as source and preserving native owned/equip grant bookkeeping.

backpackNotification.callback: OnEquipmentWeapon native 0x14699f1a0 reads main/shadow backpack arrays at +0x708/+0x770 and calls 0x1469885d0 to refresh attributes.
backpackNotification.persistence: The inspected callback does not write equipped-item arrays or call save routines.
backpackNotification.attributeBehavior: Replacing only the runtime component slot leaves backpack item selection intact. Its callback continues deriving item attributes from the original backpack item at that index.

limitations: Static native/resource evidence establishes object and grant preparation, without observing the game running.
Temporary component preparation preserves original backpack item attributes; it does not grant ownership or change the saved loadout.
Restoration must wait for native action and follow-up lifetimes and must use the original configuration interface.

configurationInterface.construction: For native PBZ_WeaponConfigBase instances and their Blueprint subclasses, write Object=configuration and InterfacePointer=configuration+0x30. For runtime reflection, traverse superclass interface lists.

interfaceConversion.luaMarshaling: The inspected UE4SS Lua InterfaceProperty pusher reads/writes only the first pointer. Construct the complete FScriptInterface through reflected native parameters for SetSlotWeapon.
